narrative.intro: PanTeXas Deterrence has $1.6B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. The vendor has one award this fiscal year and the average award size is $1.6B. Obligations fell 16.3% year over year. Historical obligations show no recorded activity in FY21, FY22, and FY23, a small entry of $13M in FY24, and $1.9B in FY25 before the current-year total. The dataset notes that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial. This profile points to a highly concentrated award picture for the current fiscal year and a sharp increase in activity between FY24 and FY25 followed by a decline into FY26 to date.
